scam.title: Is this message a scam?
scam.intro: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp message or link about your licence. Fixed rules look for common scam signs; AI only explains what the rules found.
scam.label: Message or link
scam.privacy: Don't paste your Aadhaar number, OTP or bank details. Long numbers are hidden before checking, and the text is not stored.
scam.empty: Paste a message or link first.

flags.apk_link: It asks you to install an app file (APK). Government services don't send app files by message.
flags.non_allowlisted_domain: A link goes to a site that isn't on a government domain (gov.in or nic.in).
flags.lookalike_domain: A link name imitates a transport website.
flags.upi_collect_request: It involves a UPI request. Never approve a collect request to get a service.
flags.fee_mismatch: The fee doesn't match the published fee.
flags.urgency: It pushes you to act fast.
flags.no_test_promise: It promises a licence without a test, which the process doesn't allow.
flags.otp_request: It asks for an OTP or PIN. Never share these.
flags.impersonation: It uses a transport service's name but links somewhere else.
flags.setting_offer: It offers to arrange or speed up a licence for extra money.

scam.noFlags: No known warning signs found. That doesn't prove the message is genuine.
scam.guidance: Open parivahan.gov.in yourself instead of tapping links in messages.
scam.limit: Rules can miss new tricks. When in doubt, don't pay and don't share codes.
scam.failed: The checker couldn't be reached. Don't tap the link or pay until you can check on parivahan.gov.in yourself.
